### browser_click
  element                          Text           T1
      help: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element
  target                           Text           T1 required
      help: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector
  doubleClick                      Boolean        T1
      help: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click
  button                           Choice         T1
      help: Button to click, defaults to left
      choices (3): left | right | middle
  modifiers                        PrimitiveList  T1
      help: Modifier keys to press
    (item)                         Choice         T1
        choices (5): Alt | Control | ControlOrMeta | Meta | Shift
